sources.title: SubMaroon/Kitchoon-26B-A4B · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Kitchoon-26B-A4B Gemma 4 RP model: a fused OV LoRA plus a separately trained lm_head, both on top of Pantheon-Reasoning 1.1 (heretic). Pantheon already writes clean, active prose with low slop. I wanted to keep that and add what it lacks: more decisive characters, livelier dialogue, and stronger ERP, without dragging the dataset's clichés along with it.
